rerun_accounting.rule: a production change gets a new fingerprint; every case is re-run on the combined source so no result is carried across exports
production_changes_in_this_export: core/canvas_email_service.py - create_email_canvas now writes the Canvas row as well as the CanvasAudit row

creation_invariant_finding_and_fix.defect: POST /api/canvas/email/create returned 200 with a canvas_id and wrote a CanvasAudit row with action_type='create', but NEVER inserted the Canvas row. The canvas it returned did not exist in `canvases`, so it was unreadable and uneditable while its audit trail claimed a create. The blank-canvas path in api/canvas_routes.py already requires content in BOTH places ('readers treat the audit trail as the source of truth'); the email path did not match it.
creation_invariant_finding_and_fix.fix: create_email_canvas now adds a Canvas row (name/title from subject, canvas_type='email', status='active', content mirroring the draft's to/cc/subject/body) in the same transaction as the audit row
creation_invariant_finding_and_fix.first_fix_attempt_error: 'title' is an invalid keyword argument for Canvas - the model has no title column. Caught because the service refuses to fabricate success; the harness fixture had masked this by filtering inserts to existing columns.
creation_invariant_finding_and_fix.evidence_after: verified twice: through the real service in-process (canvas row present, content_len=79, audit ['create']) and end-to-end through the live HTTP API on this export (canvas=1, audit=1 for e773826e-fe87-4299-ab96-788562fa6322)

fixture_realism_note: The controlled harness seeds canvases by direct sqlite INSERT with NO audit row - the inverse of what the product does. Every controlled result therefore rests on a fixture the product never creates. The product invariant is now verified separately through the real API; making the harness seed via the creation API is outstanding.

still_open.origin_operation_path_live: Unit-verified against real recorded evidence and wired into the harness assertions, but not exercised end to end: in every regime where the fork is taken the interactive edit leg is abandoned (_edit_response=None) and its write never applies, so the landed mutation is always the continuation's own. See c16_d1_controlled/OPEN_BLOCKER_origin_operation_path.md
